description: This file defines an ASP.NET Minimal API endpoint class for listing catalog items in a paged manner. It includes route setup, request handling, and mapping of entities to DTOs, with some filtering and pagination logic.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Endpoint class responsible for handling paged listing of catalog items via Minimal API route.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the API route for retrieving catalog items with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the request to fetch and return a paged list of catalog items, applying filters and mapping to DTOs.
